title: Senior Product Analyst
description: Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain product analytics dashboards that provide real-time visibility into user behaviour, feature adoption, and engagement across web and mobile platforms. Define and track key funnels — for example, mapping how users move from the homepage through course discovery, to a course roadmap, to individual session completion — and identify drop-off points at every stage. Segment users by behaviour, cohort, platform, and other dimensions to surface patterns in how different types of users interact with the product. Respond to ad hoc analytical requests from the Product Manager — quickly pulling and interpreting data to answer specific product questions. Partner with APMs and PMs during feature planning to define the right metrics, ensure proper event tracking is in place before launch, and evaluate outcomes post-launch. Audit and maintain the event taxonomy and tracking implementation across platforms, working with engineering to ensure data quality and completeness. Build and own a library of recurring reports — weekly/monthly — that give leadership a consistent view of product health. Proactively identify and flag unusual trends, anomalies, or opportunities in the data without waiting to be asked. What we’re looking for 3–5 years of experience in a product analyst, data analyst, or similar role within a B2C digital product environment. Proficiency with at least one product analytics platform such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase Analytics, or similar. Solid SQL skills for querying and transforming data from relational databases. Experience building dashboards and data visualisations using tools like Looker, Metabase, Tableau, or equivalent. Strong understanding of funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention metrics, and engagement tracking. Ability to communicate data findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders — in writing and in presentations. Detail-oriented and rigorous about data accuracy; you catch discrepancies before they become decisions. Comfortable working independently in a remote, async-first environment. Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,360,000.00 per year Application Question(s): Total years of experience in product data analytics? Years of experience at a product-based company? Do you have hands-on experience with Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase or CleverTap? Do you use SQL in your daily work? Have you built dashboards in Looker, Metabase or Tableau? Work Location: In person

title: IT Business Analyst
description: At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised. What You Can Expect The IT Business Analyst is a key partner to the business, supporting technology-enabled improvement across the medical device organization. Based in India and working as part of a global IT team, this role supports the Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, and Engineering Services functions by bridging business needs with compliant, practical, and scalable technology solutions. The IT Business Analyst gathers and documents business requirements, maps current- and future-state processes, and translates business needs into clear functional specifications and user stories. The role supports project delivery, testing, and deployment activities, and works closely with business subject matter experts (SMEs), IT Senior Analysts, application support teams, and vendors to ensure solutions meet operational, regulatory, and quality expectations. Work Location: Bangalore Work Mode: Hybrid(3 Days in office) How You'll Create Impact Requirements & Process Analysis Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs. Develop current-state and future-state process maps for Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs and Engineering Services processes using standard modelling techniques and tools. Translate business needs into clear user stories, functional specifications, use cases, and acceptance criteria. Perform gap analysis between current system capabilities and business needs, and recommend opportunities for improvement. Maintain requirements traceability from business need through design, testing, and deployment. Solution Support & Design Partner with IT Senior Analysts, solution architects, developers, and vendors to support the design of solutions aligned with enterprise standards and the ZB technology ecosystem. Research and evaluate software products, enhancements, and configuration options, and provide recommendations and effort estimates. Support solution designs that maintain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements (eg:FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU MDR, ISO 13485, GxP) and data privacy obligations (eg:GDPR, India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act). Support application enhancements, upgrades, and integrations across the QA/RA, Clinical, and Engineering Services application portfolio (e.g., PLM, QMS, CAD/CAE, and clinical and regulatory systems). Project Delivery, Testing & Validation Support the development and maintenance of project plans, including scope, milestones, deliverables, resources, and dependencies. Support project delivery by tracking tasks, timelines, risks, issues, and status for assigned IT initiatives. Support the documentation of technical delivery, including technical specifications, system configuration and design documents, interface specifications, and deployment/cutover plans. Prepare and execute test scenarios and scripts; coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), defect logging, and triage. Contribute to computer system validation (CSV/CSA) deliverables and ensure documentation meets GxP, data integrity, and Zimmer Biomet quality standards. Support go-live readiness, deployment, organizational change management (OCM), and post-go-live hypercare activities. Stakeholder Engagement & Business Support Act as an IT point of contact for Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, and Engineering Services stakeholders, building strong working relationships across global teams and time zones. Support the identification, assessment, and timely remediation of system vulnerabilities (e.g., security patches, version upgrades, configuration hardening) in partnership with IT Security, infrastructure teams, and vendors to ensure the security and compliance of supported systems. Analyze escalated application issues, identify root causes and recurring trends, and work with support teams and vendors to drive resolution. Develop end-user training materials, job aids, and knowledge articles (e.g., in ServiceNow), and support training sessions and user reviews of new or modified systems. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and improve data quality and reporting. Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies (including AI-enabled tools), and regulatory developments relevant to IT in the medical device industry. Contribute to business analysis best practices, templates, and knowledge assets. This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions. Responsibilities may be modified or expanded based on business needs. What Makes You Stand Out Understanding of business processes within Quality Management Systems (QMS), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, and/or Engineering/R&D (e.g., document control, CAPA, complaint handling, change control, product data management). Exposure to enterprise systems such as Windchill (PLM), EtQ (QMS), SOP/document management tools, CAD/CAE applications (e.g., NX, SolidWorks), or clinical and regulatory information systems. Awareness of IT security and vulnerability management practices in support of secure, compliant systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with global, cross-functional teams, including flexibility to support meetings with colleagues in the Americas and Europe. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results against project deadlines. Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methods and ITIL service management practices. ECBA, CCBA, or other IIBA certification, Agile/Scrum certification, or ITIL Foundation is a plus. Self-motivated, customer-service oriented, and eager to learn and take ownership. Your Background Education Bachelor’s degree (e.g., B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field is required. Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MCA, M.Tech) is a plus. Experience 2–5 years of experience in IT business analysis, systems analysis, application support, or a related technology role. Experience supporting Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, or Engineering business functions in a medical device or life sciences environment is preferred. A combination of education and experience will be considered. Language Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are required, including the ability to present, facilitate workshops, and write clear documentation for global audiences, translating technical concepts into business language and vice versa. Technical Proficiency Working knowledge of requirements management and process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps). Familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SQL) is a plus. Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Teams). Physical Requirements Travel Expectations Up to 10%, including occasional international travel to support global projects. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

description: Overview: POSITION SUMMARY STATEMENT: The Senior Product Support Analyst provides advanced technical and functional support for Herbalife digital applications to ensure reliable, high-quality, and customer-focused experiences for users across markets. The Senior Product Support Analyst partners closely with Product, Development, QA, Associate Services, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure issues are accurately documented, effectively escalated, and resolved in a timely manner. This position requires hands-on technical troubleshooting skills across web and mobile applications, backend services, databases, APIs, integrations, application logs, and monitoring tools. The individual must be able to use browser developer tools, console logs, SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, session-replay tools such as Quantum Metric, and logging/observability tools such as Splunk to investigate application behavior and customer-reported issues. The Senior Product Support Analyst may also support software projects and releases from requirements clarification through implementation, UAT, Hypercare, production validation, and ongoing maintenance. This role contributes to support documentation, reporting, and enhancement recommendations that improve application usability, reliability, and customer experience. DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES: Serve as a subject-matter expert for assigned digital applications and provide Level 2 technical and functional support for web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. Investigate application behavior across frontend components, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication flows, and third-party dependencies. Participate in incident reviews and root-cause analysis; document and track corrective and preventive actions through completion. Support release-readiness activities, including requirements clarification, UAT, production validation, Hypercare, post-release monitoring, and stabilization support. Partner closely with Product Managers, Developers, Operations, Associate Services, and business stakeholders to investigate issues, clarify business rules, coordinate resolution, and improve product usability and reliability. You'll partner directly with product, design, and engineering to drive how we grow the direct-to-consumer funnel — from the moment someone lands on the site, through quote and approval, to activating their policy. You use it to find the highest-leverage questions, spot opportunities the team hasn't seen yet, and bring recommendations that change roadmap decisions rather than just describe what happened. The AI infrastructure we've built changes what this role looks like day to day. Mechanical analysis is faster than it has ever been, which frees you to spend your time on the parts that need judgment: framing the right question, validating what the tools produce, and drawing the conclusion the business should act on. You partner with PMs across the Consumer funnel — landing page, quote flow, onboarding, approval, and activation — to define success metrics, find where users drop off, and make sure decisions are grounded in data. PMs make different calls because you're in the room. Be accountable for outcomes, not output. Design, instrument, and interpret A/B and multivariate tests — from CTA and quote-flow changes to eligibility and onboarding — with the statistical rigor to separate real lift from noise, and help raise the quality and speed of how the team runs experiments. Deep experience designing and interpreting experiments and applying statistical rigor — regression, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing. Daily use of AI tools in your analytics workflow, with a clear-eyed sense of where they accelerate the work, where they get it wrong, and where your own judgment is non-negotiable. We bridge the gap between raw customer data and strategic business decisions turning feedback, behavioral analytics, and qualitative research into experiences that delight users and drive long-term loyalty. Working closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Support, we don’t just report on what customers are doing; we uncover why they do it and champion the changes that make their journey effortless. Role Overview: We are seeking a data-driven, empathetic Customer Insights Analyst to uncover the "why" behind customer behavior. You will bridge the gap between raw behavioral data and direct customer feedback, translating complex quantitative and qualitative findings into actionable recommendations that drive product innovation, improve customer retention, and sharpen our go-to-market strategy. Key Responsibilities: Data Analysis & Segmentation: Analyze behavioral, transactional, and demographic datasets to identify trends, build customer segments, and map end-to-end customer journeys. Primary & Secondary Research: Design, execute, and analyze customer surveys, focus groups, usability tests, and in-depth interviews to capture Voice of the Customer (VoC) sentiment and pain points. Campaign & Product Measurement: Track key customer health metrics (e.g NPS, CSAT, churn rate, Customer Lifetime Value) Reporting & Visualization: Build and maintain self-service dashboards and automated reports that monitor customer behavior in real time. Data Storytelling & Stakeholder Alignment: Synthesize findings from disparate sources into clear, executive-ready presentations, pitching strategic recommendations to Product, Marketing, Sales, and CX teams. Data Governance: Ensure all customer research and data handling adhere strictly to data privacy regulations, consent protocols, and ethical research standards. Required Qualifications & Skills Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Psychology, or a related quantitative/research field. Experience: 2–4+ years of experience in customer analytics, market research, CRM analytics, or business intelligence. Technical & Analytical Stack: Strong proficiency in SQL for querying large relational databases and Excel/Google Sheets for modeling. Hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker . Familiarity with survey and VoC platforms (e.g. Medallia, Survey Sparrow) Soft Skills: Exceptional storytelling ability capable of turning statistical outputs into compelling business narratives for non-technical stakeholders. High intellectual curiosity, structured problem-solving skills, and strong attention to detail. Location: Decathlon Anubhava, Bangalore

title: Senior Analyst - Data & Analytics
description: Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. THE ROLE We are looking for a senior analyst who builds. Not someone who specs a dashboard and hands it to a BI developer — someone who takes an ambiguous business question, models the data behind it, designs the interface, ships it as a working web application, and then sits with the stakeholder who uses it. You'll work across the business — People, Finance, Products, and other lines of business — building custom, web-based analytics products that people actually open on a Monday morning. You'll use AI and GenAI tools (including Claude) to move from idea to deployed prototype in days rather than quarters, without the constraints of traditional BI platforms. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will spend your time in SQL, in data models, in code, and in front of the people who depend on what you build. What You'll Do Own analytics products end to end. Gather requirements directly from business stakeholders, model the underlying data, build the dashboard, validate it, deploy it, and iterate on real usage independently. Design and ship custom web-based dashboards. Build intelligent, self-serve analytics experiences as real web applications, using AI and GenAI tools to rapidly prototype and implement solutions that off-the- shelf BI tools can't deliver. Make the data trustworthy. Build clean, well-documented data models in SQL. Partner with data engineering and platform engineering so what you ship is scalable, reliable, and audit-ready in production. Design for the reader, not the data. Decide what belongs on the screen and what doesn't. Make hierarchy, layout, and chart choice do real work, so an executive gets the answer in five seconds and an analyst can still drill to the detail. Turn findings into decisions. Translate complex analysis into a clear narrative for senior leadership — making the story behind the numbers as rigorous as the numbers themselves — and follow through until the insight changes something. Prototype where AI helps. Explore and deploy AI-powered analytics capabilities — natural-language querying, automated narrative, anomaly surfacing — where they make a product genuinely more useful. Become the domain expert. Learn the business processes behind the numbers deeply enough that your outputs are grounded in real strategy, not just in what data happens to exist. Proven ability to build and deploy web-based analytics applications. You've shipped dashboards as real web apps, not just BI workbooks. Comfortable with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, or with frameworks such as React, Streamlit, Dash, or Plotly — and with using AI coding tools to get from prototype to production quickly. You can run the full lifecycle alone: stakeholder conversation → data model → built dashboard → deployed and adopted. Strong communication. You can hold a room of senior leaders, defend your numbers, and influence decisions without formal authority.
